senses.gloss: m. (כַּרְכֵּשׁ I) large intestines, great-gut and rectum).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 82a">Sabb. 82ᵃ</cite> [read with Rashi:] <he>האי כ׳ … יתיב</he> (or with Ms. O. <he>כַּרְכַּשְׁתָּא … יתבא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the rectum is supported by three teeth-like glands.
<cite ref="Gittin 57a">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 62b:6">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>שמטיה לכַרְכְּשֵׁיה</he> he dropped his gut (from fright).
<cite ref="Chullin 49b:13">Ḥull. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>חיטי דכ׳</he> the fat glands surrounding the large intestines.
